verdict.rationale: Productboard's integrations directory names Zendesk among its integrations and says it can 'Import sales & support conversations' and 'Import messages containing ideas & feedback'. A Microsoft Teams integration is also listed, and the REST API is documented as a way to route feedback from proprietary CRMs and other non-native sources. Together this covers the core of connecting feedback capture to existing support, sales, and chat tools. Missing for 10: named native sales/CRM connectors (the evidence only cites the API for CRMs), detail on how the Zendesk and chat-tool feedback capture works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
